instruction_summary: Continuation (003) of Study 001: extend HHJK (2019) talent-misallocation to a pooled 2022-2024 ACS '2023' period, re-estimate the growth-accounting conclusion, with all validation gates and both deflator conventions.

steps.description: Rebuilt container env (venv; micromamba gnuplot 6.0.5; fontredirect.so).
steps.command: uv venv; micromamba create gp gnuplot; gcc fontredirect

steps.description: Gate 3b resolved: fetched Census 2010-2012 3-year PUMS (1.61GB); 3-yr file reproduces shipped pop-shares a=0.0000 & occ Duncan b=0.0000 exactly, ln-wage c<=0.019; only earnings-level d<=1.9% off (dollar-convention, immaterial to tau). semantic_pass=true.
Gate 2 refactor-equivalence PASS (fixed p-loop clobber, diff shadow, exp-rescale spacing): 15/15 share rows byte-identical (41.5/36.0/7.7); remaining-gain 13.4..9.9.
Gate 2b PASS: implemented how_much_poorer(t0,t1)+incumbent rule; t0=t1 zero-contribution, assignment table, nesting byte-exact.
Finished NY-generalization missed by 001 (estimatetauz, solveeqm, SolveForEqm, display, color vectors, incumbent-cohort test c==Nyears+1|Nyears+2, pce extend 135.33).
Built 2023 period (pooled 2022-2024 PUMS, PWGTP/3, W* bridged white, occ2018 modal, ADJINC*PCE, floor $1471) + chad_output_file_living.csv (old cohorts +1; new 1/2/3). unmapped 0.0.
Ran Living (paper deflator) and LivingDefl (corrected pce2010=106.17) cases S1-S3 + L3(t0=1,t1=7)+L4(t0=6,t1=7)+L4b(t0=5,t1=6)+group chunks + per-decade windows, stage-split.
Gate 7 stability PASS: raw tauhat(1960-2010) identical 6<->7 period (max rel 5e-16); mean shift traced to aggregation-weight vector.
Gate 5 (race q + Hispanic share), Gate 6 (2023 LFP 0.792 PASS), L9 (WM doc+law share), L1/L2 tau_paths, 2 figures, deliverables.
Robustness variant CSVs built (R1 W_NH, R2 W_lit, R3 2024-only, R4 SPLIT, R8 cohort bands); cases run per growth_shares.csv. R6 (corrected-deflator L3)=38.5.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Share of 1960-end mkt-GDP/person growth from falling tau (TauWTauH Ymkt)
comparison_to_original.note: friction contribution share slightly lower extending to 2023

comparison_to_original.quantity: Share of final-decade growth from falling tau
comparison_to_original.note: flat at a low level; the big decline predates 2010
edged down; now almost entirely labour-market wedge

deviations: Gate 3b strict 1% tol on earnings LEVEL (d) not met by either route (1-yr pool 0.49%, 3-yr file 1.9%); a pure IPUMS-CPI vs Census-ADJINC dollar-convention residual that cancels in all tau estimands/growth shares. All semantic dimensions validated (pop-shares a=0.0000, Duncan b=0.0000 on the 3-yr file). Proceeded with documentation rather than a literal stop.
L7 (per-occupation illustrative WW tau figure) omitted as redundant with L1/fig1.
2023 cohort middle band does not perfectly match the 2010-young birth cohort (~8/10 overlap); R8 bounds this.
